classification_definitions.admitted_success: Hook admitted and matching non-error tool_result observed; usefulness is not judged.
classification_definitions.admitted_error: Hook admitted and matching error tool_result observed.
classification_definitions.budget_denied: Hook denied and matching error tool_result contains the frozen budget message; not an executed retrieval error.
classification_definitions.unresolved: No matching tool_result; includes pending denied calls. budget_denied_unresolved is a subset.
classification_definitions.no_hook: Admission-based counts are null; no budget compliance is inferred.
classification_definitions.duplicates: Unique tool_use_id; repeated results count once, conflicting flags retain error and raise audit issue.

limitations: No answer-quality judgment or statistical inference.
Budget parameters and elapsed times are recorded hook/controller evidence, not independent wall-clock metering.
Complete input includes repeated cached context; reported provider billing is not verified.
